content: Add require_admin to all admin route endpoints (custom fields, routing rules, SLA policies, escalation rules)
Fix portal category CRUD authorization (require_admin instead of get_current_user)
Add re.escape() to customer search regex to prevent NoSQL injection
Sanitize error messages in auth.py, email.py, knowledge_base.py - never return str(e)
Externalize hardcoded CSAT base URL to environment variable
Add rate limiting to portal auth endpoints (register + login)
Strengthen portal password policy (min 8 chars + complexity rules)
